title: launch-cumulative-screening: a stochastic-scheduling framework for cumulative-effects screening of high-cadence launch and landing operations
description:
A stochastic-scheduling framework for screening how cumulative-effect metrics scale with operating frequency, applied to the proposed increase in Starship-Super Heavy launch and landing operations at the Boca Chica Launch Site (FAA docket FAA-2026-12808). The repository contains the launchcum package, the transcribed and digitized FAA per-operation inputs, the experiments, the manuscript and supporting information, and the scoping comment with its technical attachment.

The framework treats operations as a marked point process on the calendar, evaluates four classes of metric (additive, energy-averaged, number-above and exceedance-day, coverage and interval) plus public-access availability, and quantifies the error of extrapolating per-operation or annual-average assessments linearly to higher cadence, with a global sensitivity analysis over the uncertain inputs. Per-event footprints are the FAA's own modeled values; the results are statements about metric behavior, not estimates of actual impacts.
